record_basis: completed TAP result captured in agent tool output; this summary is not a rerun
tests: actual SDK discovery and scan are stateless, bounded and profile-pinned
unauthorized HTTP requests do not invoke the scanner or disclose keys
upstream errors, timeouts and incomplete verdicts fail without hidden retries
independent concurrent clients preserve their own results
typed upstream failures log safe metadata once and never return sensitive errors
diagnostics reject arbitrary correlations and never serialize unknown errors
a failed diagnostic sink preserves the original fail-closed tool result
